A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] '''individual''' served as a [[Jedi scout|scout]] for the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Around [[22,800 BBY]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force sense/Legends|sensed]] a powerful resonance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] while wandering [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]]. Following the sensation, the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] traveled in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to the previously unknown [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]]. There, the Jedi explored the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], but the scout's findings failed to explain the presence in the Force possessed by that world, which was later discovered to be due to the planet's deposits of various [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|crystals]] that could be used in the construction of Jedi [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]].

==Biography==
Around [[22,800 BBY]],<ref name="TEA" /> an individual served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi scout|scout]].<ref name="NoP" /> At one point around that [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="TEA" /> while using [[Instinctive astrogation|Force-assisted]] [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Astrogation/Legends|navigation]] to wander along [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Force sense/Legends|perceived]] a particularly powerful resonance in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] that seemed like a siren call to her. The Jedi heeded the pull of the resonance<ref name="NoP" /> and traveled in a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to the sensation's point of origin, which was located so deep in unexplored [[Realspace/Legends|space]] as to render reaching it almost impossible.<ref name="TEA" />

[[File:Ilum_FDNP.png|thumb|right|220px|The Jedi scout discovered the planet Ilum.]]
Eventually, upon opening his [[Eye/Legends|eyes]], the [[Scout/Legends|scout]] discovered the ship had arrived in the<ref name="TEA" /> previously unknown and [[Star map/Legends|uncharted]]<ref name="NoP" /> [[Ilum system/Legends|Ilum system]], a part of the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. In the forward [[Viewport/Legends|viewports]] of the vessel, the frozen [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] lay visible to the scout.<ref name="TEA" /> Although the entire [[Star system/Legends|star system]] had a strong presence in the Force, Ilum particularly attracted the scout's senses, leading to the Jedi focusing attention on the planet. The scout made reports on the hostile conditions of Ilum's surface, but those did not explain the planet's strong presence in the Force, which was discovered by a subsequent survey team to be the planet's rich deposits of<ref name="NoP" /> [[Kathracite crystal/Legends|kathracite]],<ref name="TEA" /> [[Mephite crystal/Legends|mephite]], and [[Pontite crystal/Legends|pontite]] [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]], which could be [[Lightsaber crystal/Legends|used]] in the construction of Jedi [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] weapons.<ref name="NoP" />

The Jedi scout's discovery of Ilum later lay the foundation for a traditional Jedi journey to the planet. The journey was made via single uninterrupted hyperspace jump directly from [[Metellos/Legends|Metellos]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] and could only be accomplished by [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] with a strong [[Force-sensitive/Legends|connection]] to the Force.<ref name="TEA" /> Despite the importance of the discovery of Ilum to the Jedi Order, the name of the scout who found it was eventually lost to history.<ref name="NoP" />

==Powers and abilities==
The Jedi scout was a skilled Force-user who could draw upon the Force to assist with hyperspace navigation.<ref name="NoP" /> The scout was also able to pilot a starship.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi scout who discovered the planet Ilum was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', which was authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="TEA" />
